name: Fernwhisp · Gremlet #41
description:
A curled-up fern frond that unrolls a little more every morning.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Fernwhisp in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
